guide: Open Start and type your company name and your limits in the yellow cells: host agency rate, advisor rate, chase days, escalation days, grace days, smallest claim and the share you want to keep.
Check Team, Suppliers, Trips and Bookings. They hold the people, the supplier commission rates and terms, and every booking a commission can come from.
Add a row on Commissions for each booking that earns commission: expected amount and date. Received amount, received date and status are filled in when the supplier pays.
Read Commissions every week: days overdue, ageing band and next step show what to chase, wait for or escalate.
Record every chase on Chase Log with the answer and the promised date. Broken promises and slow answers are flagged for you.
Use Short-pay Claims, Clawbacks and Rate History to catch short payments, commissions taken back and supplier rate changes.
Type the host agency statement on Host Statements each month and compare it with what you recorded. Keep your yearly sales next to Host Tiers.
Run Advisor Payouts each month: agency share, advisor rate, payout, year to date and what is still owed.
Watch Commission Forecast, Supplier Pay Calendar and Unclaimed Commissions for what is coming and what must be claimed.
Track Supplier Bonuses against each sales target and Service Fees with their payment status.
Read Commission by Category, Ageing and Owner Net Earnings for the monthly picture and what the business keeps.
Use the 14 calculators for commission splits, net earnings per trip, ageing, chase priority, short-pay checks, escalation, host tiers, payouts, forecasts, clawbacks, quotes, bonuses and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in. Read the Commission Dashboard and Charts every week.

listing.title: Travel Agent Commissions and Host Split Excel Template: Commission Tracker, Ageing, Chase Log, Payouts, Forecast, Net Earnings
listing.headline: Know what every trip earns and chase every unpaid commission
listing.description:
Run the commission side of an independent travel agent or travel advisor business in one Excel workbook. Commissions holds every commission a supplier owes (the share of the price a supplier pays the advisor after travel) with the expected amount and date, what arrived and when, and then shows the days overdue, an ageing band of 30, 60 and 90 days, the share kept by the host agency (the larger agency whose booking access and supplier deals an independent advisor uses, for a share of each commission), the agency share, the advisor payout and any short payment. Bookings, Trips and Suppliers show what each booking, trip and supplier should earn, what has arrived and what is unpaid.

Chase Log records every call and message to a supplier with the answer and the promised date, and flags broken promises and slow answers. The Commission Ageing and Chase Priority calculators show who to chase first, and the Escalation to the Host Agency calculator shows when to hand a commission over. Short-pay Claims, Clawbacks (a commission taken back after a cancellation) and Rate History catch the money that goes missing between the rate you agreed and the amount paid.

Host Statements compares the host agency statement with your own records, and Host Tiers with the Host Tier Planner shows the rate you pay and the sales needed for the next tier. Advisor Payouts gives each advisor a monthly payout, a year to date and what is still owed. Commission Forecast, Supplier Pay Calendar, Unclaimed Commissions, Supplier Bonuses, Commission by Category, Service Fees and Owner Net Earnings show what is coming and what the business keeps.

14 calculators cover commission splits, net earnings per trip, ageing, chase priority, short payments, escalation, host tiers, payouts, forecasts, supplier pay time, clawbacks, commission on a quote, bonuses and a host and advisor rate what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part three of the Travel Agent suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small advisor business to explore first. It helps you track your commissions and does not promise results.

ru.Check Team, Suppliers, Trips and Booking: Проверьте команду, поставщиков, поездки и бронирования. Они держат людей, ставки и условия комиссионных поставщиков, а также каждое бронирование, с которого может быть получена комиссия.

ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Распечатайте 10 листов и 10 документов, следуйте 10 контрольным спискам и коснитесь ссылки на сообщение, чтобы отправить текстовое сообщение с уже написанной информацией. Каждую неделю читайте Панель управления комиссиями и диаграммы.

ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.

es.Open Start and type your company name an: Abra Inicio y escriba el nombre de su empresa y sus límites en las celdas amarillas: tarifa de la agencia de viajes anfitriona, tarifa del asesor, días de persecución, días de escalada, días de gracia, reclamo más pequeño y la participación que desea conservar.
es.Check Team, Suppliers, Trips and Booking: Consulta Equipo, Proveedores, Viajes y Reservas. Ellos controlan a las personas, las tasas y los términos de comisión de los proveedores, y de cada reserva puede surgir una comisión.
es.Add a row on Commissions for each bookin: Agregue una fila sobre Comisiones para cada reserva que gane comisión: monto esperado y fecha. El monto recibido, la fecha de recepción y el estado se completan cuando el proveedor paga.
es.Read Commissions every week: days overdu: Lea Comisiones cada semana: días vencidos, franja vencida y siguiente paso muestran qué perseguir, esperar o intensificar.
es.Record every chase on Chase Log with the: Graba cada persecución del registro de persecución con la respuesta y la fecha prometida. Se le marcan promesas incumplidas y respuestas lentas.

es.Type the host agency statement on Host S: Escriba el extracto de la agencia de viajes anfitriona el Declaraciones del anfitrión cada mes y compárelo con lo que registró. Mantenga sus ventas anuales junto a Niveles de host.

es.Read Commission by Category, Ageing and: Lea Comisión por categoría, Envejecimiento y Ganancias netas del propietario para conocer el panorama mensual y lo que conserva la empresa.
es.Use the 14 calculators for commission sp: Utilice las 14 calculadoras para dividir comisiones, ganancias netas por viaje, antigüedad, prioridad de persecución, cheques de pago corto, escalamiento, niveles de anfitrión, pagos, pronósticos, recuperaciones, cotizaciones, bonificaciones y qué pasaría si.
es.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 hojas y 10 documentos, siga 10 listas de verificación y toque el enlace de un mensaje para enviar un texto con los detalles ya escritos. Lea el Panel de comisiones y los gráficos todas las semanas.

es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.
es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.
es.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos actualizados con los datos de tus hojas. Elige en las celdas amarillas y los gráficos e indicadores se actualizarán automáticamente.
